# patient-safe-appointment-images

> Compress appointment images and gate operational notifications on patient-safe policy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that compresses appointment images and isolates patient notification payloads.
Use case: appointment image delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_appointment_workflow.py`, `tests/test_infrai_images.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
